svg.title: A tail is a smaller valid tile
svg.desc: Follow edge regions in a rectangular [5,7] times [7,3] multiplication. Block dimensions BM=4, BK=4, BN=2; ranges are half-open. Last tile i=4..5, k=4..7, j=2..3; no contribution is discarded. Bounds use saturating addition and min; blocked inputs must be canonical.
svg.text: A tail is a smaller valid tile
Follow edge regions in a rectangular [5,7] times [7,3] multiplication.
Cells show flat offsets, not values.
Last tile: i 4..5, k 4..7, j 2..3; all half-open. Underlines mark edge regions.
ii → kk → jj selects tiles; i → k → j updates C from independent A and B inputs.
Block dimensions BM=4, BK=4, BN=2; ranges are half-open.
Last tile i=4..5, k=4..7, j=2..3; no contribution is discarded.
Bounds use saturating addition and min; blocked inputs must be canonical.
